in_marathi.name: Jhilmil
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jhilmil हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jhilmil is derived from the Sanskrit word 'jhilamila' which means 'moonbeam' or 'raindrop'. It is a name deeply rooted in Hindu and Sanskrit tradition.
